Parent changes: asset_category 223 (all EQUITY_COMMON to LOAN), shares_held 41 (all to null; principal unchanged), issuer_name 3 and instrument_description 3 (RSC Topco), maturity_precision 6 and maturity_status 6 (the reverted rows), corrected_fields 9, position_id 1 (an EQUITY_COMMON row re-chained, consistent with the declared RSC Topco re-chain). index_classification and asset_class are unchanged, so the 281 + 14 structured-credit reclasses are kept. coordinator_questions.maturity_precision_mechanism: Confirmed in code. In pipeline/financial_conventions.py, precision_value gives 'day' only from a stored precision, a parseable maturity_raw, or maturity_date_source IN ('xbrl_field','nport','printed_page'); else 'unknown'. pipeline/bdc_xbrl_html_bridge.py apply_ixbrl_field_status_overlay labels bridge-filled maturities 'ixbrl_field_status' ('a bridge-filled value is NOT a structured XBRL tag'). In bcpf, all 22,361 dated BCRED rows have source ixbrl_field_status, no maturity_raw, and precision unknown. Addition for the owner: in the cohort build the 278,033 'unresolved'-with-date rows are 267,603 ixbrl_field_status (94 funds), 10,410 identifier_text (45 funds) and 20 with no source. The per-source detector covers both labels, but the observation names only the first.
coordinator_questions.class_in_name_search: Not fully supported. A search of bcpf parent rows with an empty instrument_description finds no class phrase (common, preferred, units, shares, warrants, interests, class/series X) except 'AIMCO CLO Series 2015-A', a CLO name. But a listing of every non-loan row with an empty instrument finds 'Pigments LP Int' (5 parent rows, 2023-06-30 to 2024-06-30, fair value 0). The page prints it as one cell 'Pigments LP Int (4)(6)(16) 3,943', and from 2024-09-30 the fund publishes 'Pigments Holdings LP' with instrument 'LP Interest'. That is the same class-in-name pattern, abbreviated.

observation_reviews.rationale: Re-reviewed after the report-only edit. The false 'no other variant' claim is withdrawn in both the observation and the fix text. 'Pigments LP Int' (5 parent rows, 2023-06-30 to 2024-06-30, fair value 0, no instrument) is recorded as left, with action parked and a not_done entry. Its quote 'Chemicals Pigments LP Int (4)(6)(16) - - 0.00' is on the 0001803498-23-000017 page. I ran the widened check myself (class or instrument phrase, full or abbreviated, after a separator, empty instrument) on bcpf published rows: it returns exactly 'Pigments LP Int' x5, with no false alarms on BCRED. Residual risk: the 5 rows stay wrong in the data until the next build applies the context-keyed split. They are zero fair value. Note: the report's top-level 'parked' list is still empty; the parking is recorded only on the observation and in not_done.
